Name: EnMotion
Author: Enjuchan
Punchline: Shows which emotes your mods change, and plays them.
Description: Lists emotes, dances, expressions and idle poses altered by Penumbra mods and plays them with one click. Keep favourites at hand, filter by mod, jump straight to an idle pose, and use the compact view to keep it open while you play. Requires Penumbra.
